root: ^"Has the little Witch finally come to subdue the evil siren..?"

^Where is that insufferable Narrator? Isn't he following you?"
nod_choice1: ^"My. Don't tell me you're another witch?"
confused_choice: ^"In that case, little witch, can you help me gather my precious objects and put them in the right place, and in return, I'll help you get away from that Narrator."
siren_after_puzzle: ^"As promised, I'll help you get away from the Narrator."
